summary: Perry County, OH tower completed in 1941 on the Isaac Danison farm, listed as Maxville or Kehota; listed as gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on the Ohio list of the Forest Fire Lookout Association
facts.agency: Wayne National Forest, per the Forest Lookouts page

events.note: Completed on a Friday on the farm of Isaac Danison; reported by The Logan Daily News on November 22, 1941

evidence.supports: Site is in Perry County, Ohio
Register lists the site as Maxville Tower Site
Maxville is an unincorporated community in Perry County
evidence.quote: Maxville is an unincorporated community in Perry County

evidence.supports: Post office at Maxville from 1855 until 1904
evidence.quote: A post office was established at Maxville in 1855, and remained in operation until 1904

evidence.supports: Tower completed on a Friday on the farm of Isaac Danison
evidence.quote: The lookout tower was completed Friday on the farm of Isaac Danison.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page gives the agency as Wayne National Forest
Forest Lookouts page files the tower under Kehota
Ohio list shows the tower as Kehota (Maxville), gone, register US 1566, OH 12
evidence.quote: Kehota (Maxville) Perry 39.61974 -82.29704 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1566, OH 12

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register uses Maxville and the Forest Lookouts page uses Kehota; the Ohio list gives both names for the same tower

sources.title: Kehota (quoting The Logan Daily News, November 22, 1941)

notes_for_editor: Only one 1941 newspaper line describes the tower; nothing on staffing, fires, removal or the site today. Register coordinates (39.619583, -82.297222) sit about 3 km from Wikipedia's coordinates for the Maxville community, so the register point may be the tower site rather than the village centre. The Forest Lookouts page cites the 1941 report as its only source. No photo found.
